facts.c: ABA Bank: a foreigner opens an account at any ABA branch, aged 18 or over, with the original valid passport with a valid visa, a document proving residential status, and the application form
facts.q: Bring the original and valid Passport (with valid visa) and any document that proves your residential status
facts.note: Same page: 'You can open account at any ABA Bank branch.' 'For foreigners - Be at least 18 years old'.

facts.c: ABA Bank accepts as proof of residence: a multiple-entry visa without leaving Cambodia for at least 182 days a year; a rental contract or certificate of address of at least 6 months; or an employment contract or certificate of employment showing at least 6 months' employment
facts.q: Proof of employment (employment contract, certificate of employment) indicating a minimum of 6 months employment
facts.note: Same list: 'Multiple-entry visa without leaving the country for at least 182 days in a year'; 'Proof of residence (house rental contract. certificate of residential address, hotel lease/bill) including a minimum of 6 months tenor'.

facts.c: ABA current account: USD 100 (or KHR 400,000) to open and as the minimum balance; no monthly fee; no fee to close
facts.note: Same page: 'Monthly account service | Free'; 'There's no fee for account closure.' FAQ gives minimum ongoing balance USD 20, table USD 100.

facts.c: ABA: a customer with no transaction for 4 years is charged an abandonment fee of USD 50, and USD 100 a year from year 5
facts.note: Next row: 'Year 5 and up | USD 100.00 / KHR 400,000'.

facts.c: ABA Bank general hotline for account questions: 1 800 203 203
ABA Bank offers an Interest-free Mode for the Muslim community
